review_question: In adults hospitalized with acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding, does colonoscopy within 24 hours reduce persistent or recurrent bleeding compared with elective colonoscopy after 24 hours?

pico.population: Adults hospitalized with acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding or hematochezia
pico.intervention_or_exposure: Colonoscopy within 24 hours of presentation or admission
pico.comparator: Elective or standard colonoscopy after 24 hours, with permitted standard diagnostic management
pico.outcome: Persistent or recurrent bleeding after index examination

outcome.description: Source-reported persistent or recurrent lower gastrointestinal bleeding after the index examination

targets.comparison: Elective or standard colonoscopy after 24 hours, with permitted standard diagnostic management
targets.population_or_subgroup: Adults hospitalized with acute lower gastrointestinal bleeding or hematochezia

timepoint_policy.rule: Preserve each trial's reported post-index-examination follow-up window; do not replace it with a target-review value.

candidate_capture_policy.record_scope: one source-reported eligible arm-level outcome per report

targets.quantitative_use_policy: Extract events and denominators in both randomized arms, the source definition, follow-up window, and a verified source location. Do not copy an RR from a review forest plot.

output_contract.effect_unit: one randomized trial arm-level further-bleeding comparison
